components.name: Relation-conditioned witness precision for radical-support collapse
components.project_addition: Use radical as an explicit finite multiplicative-support collapse; expose the forgotten multiplicity residual with exact integer coordinates; separate witness existence radius, arithmetic absorption floor, floor-access radius and the full norm/absorption Pareto frontier; derive the exact absorption floor first from a scaled exterior/determinantal signature and then directly from support blocks plus valuation exponents; resolve that floor into prime-local obstruction coordinates, including prime factors of valuation exponents outside rad(abc); falsify the naive high-quality-implies-perfect-absorption shortcut; construct floor witnesses by Bezout syzygies while preserving the negative boundary that constructive existence can be far from minimum precision; solve the exact floor-access radius for three prime coordinates as a one-dimensional affine integer interval problem; specialize 1+qr=p^m to a two-variable Diophantine minimum and separate continuous balancing from a finite integrality-access defect with a sharp coefficient-only bound. P023 generic query-generated repair and A3/A4 Pareto-antichain semantics remain upstream mother structures rather than P025 claims. The project does not claim the underlying radical, Mason-Stothers, arithmetic-derivative, Wronskian, Smith/determinantal-divisor, exterior-algebra, Bezout/syzygy, closest-lattice-point, Pareto/Dickson, Diophantine-optimization, derivation-generalization, or exceptional-set mathematics.
